verdict.rationale: USPTO states that TEAS trademark forms can be previewed without logging in on a form-previews page, so the forms can be inspected before the account wall, which otherwise applies to filing. The evidence covers only previewing trademark forms, not downloading them or their instructions. Missing for 10: evidence that forms are downloadable (not just previewable), downloadable form instructions without an account, coverage of patent forms, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
